isolation.method: hidden tests and grader executed on an isolated staging copy outside the frozen benchmark; outputs redirected to files; hidden results never surfaced to the agent session

notes: update_node_risk() now marks the rewritten node dirty so _collect_dirty_nodes() includes it and its descendants, and the next compute_risk_propagation() recomputes that subgraph instead of returning the cached aggregate. The incremental cache itself is untouched: unchanged nodes still hit cache, _total_risk_cache / _topo_cache / _dirty_nodes all remain in place, and no path recomputes the whole graph. No public API, method signature or return structure changed; no test or grader file was touched.
